data.content_ref: inline:The problem demands distinguishing idempotent from safe 'drawing on published definitions.' SRC_002 never cites or engages any published definition of either term. It asserts the distinction is 'one of layering' (idempotency = writer property, safety = storage property), but this is an architectural taxonomy, not the definitional distinction the question asks for. Under published definitions (e.g., RFC 9110), 'safe' means the operation produces no observable side-effects and 'idempotent' means repeated execution yields the same effect — both are properties of individual operations, not of system layers. By substituting a layering argument for the requested definitional distinction, SRC_002 leaves the first half of the problem unanswered and provides no causal mechanism grounded in the semantics of the published terms.
